record.title: Supply one isolated DHCP lease and observe address acquisition
record.intent: Measure the already-powered instrument's response to IPv4 assignment alone.
requirements: Preserve separate private evidence with UTC and local timestamps, current host state and restoration information; verify identified Ethernet interface, separate default route, disabled forwarding, sharing, NAT and bridging before intervention.

Commit admitted tasking before execution. Prepare a responder restricted to the observed specimen MAC and one private address, with no router, DNS or route options and no reachability probes. Validate reply construction offline before connecting the responder.

Start and verify a fresh full Ethernet capture before DHCP. Preserve complete packets without a restrictive capture filter, with live decoding and isolation observation. Prefer an Ethernet-level responder without host interface addressing to avoid unrelated host traffic.

Observe passively for five minutes after the captured DHCP ACK. Record negotiation, assigned address, newly emitted traffic, attempted destinations and operator-reported UI changes. Stop for evidence of external reachability, automatic updates or unexpected state-changing behavior.
No Web Control, SCPI, ADB, USB, scans, service discovery, authentication approval or device configuration changes. Stop DHCP responder after the single lease exchange and preserve host isolation.
acceptance: A sealed passive post-ACK observation or a documented stop condition preserves the address-only intervention.
